LanguageData.fcPrimaryColorDesc: Applied to armor and outer layers (e.g. flak vests, plate armor, dusters). When no secondary is set, applies to all apparel.
LanguageData.fcSecondaryColorDesc: Applied to base clothing (e.g. shirts, pants), headgear, belts, and accessories.
LanguageData.fcColorsRandomInfo: Pawns will generate with random colors when no faction colors are set.
LanguageData.FCFactionTitleDesc: Your polity's type - Empire, Kingdom, Republic, Commune, etc.
LanguageData.FCInvalidFaction: That faction can't run an empire on its own!
LanguageData.FCFactionHappinessDesc: The measure of the faction's overall happiness. A high happiness means that any internal conflict within the settlement will lean heavily to your favor.
LanguageData.FCFactionLoyaltyDesc: The measure of the faction's overall loyalty. The loyalty of a settlement determines how willing the settlement is to listen to you. A high loyalty will reduce the chance of defection.
LanguageData.FCFactionUnrestDesc: The measure of the faction's overall unrest. The higher unrest grows, the more likely dangerous events internal in your faction will spark. Let it grow too high, and a faction-wide revolt may grow.
LanguageData.FCFactionProsperityDesc: The measure of the faction's overall prosperity. The prosperity of a town directly correlates with the production of resources. 50% prosperity = 50% production. If prosperity is damaged, it will slowly accumulate over time.
